note: Mainland Luzon province context for the Maddela locator: Regions I, III, IV-A, V (mainland provinces), Cordillera Administrative Region, and NCR (four district polygons merged into one), plus the Maddela municipality feature reused from maddela-boundaries-codab.geojson. Batanes, Catanduanes, and Masbate island provinces are excluded as owner-directed scope. Simplified from the OCHA COD-AB geodatabase with Douglas-Peucker (1px at 200px width). Stylized web rendering; not an official survey boundary.
